candidateOccurrences.sourceText: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.
